nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) holding token balances in phononfinance.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spender allowances.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Private privileged owner address used by delegate and batchSend access checks.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals value (18).
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) forwarding to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) guarded by ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only delegate(address a, bytes memory b) executing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address.
Owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) looping and mutating balances with unchecked math.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender and initial balances/allowance.
Internal pure pairFor computing a deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256 and init code hash.
Modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) requiring _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == computed UNI pair.
msg.sender caller-supplied address used for authorization, allowance keys and privileged checks.
a.delegatecall(b) arbitrary external delegatecall with no success check on owner-controlled target a.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction allowing integer underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition allowing integer overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction of spender allowance.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
address _to destination parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
uint _value amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and batchSend.
address _from source parameter of transferFrom used to index balances and allowances.
address _spender parameter of approve.
address a delegatecall target parameter of delegate.
bytes b calldata parameter passed to delegatecall in delegate.
address[] _tos recipient array parameter of batchSend.
string _name constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
string _symbol constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
uint256 _supply constructor parameter assigned to totalSupply and owner balance.
address factory parameter of pairFor hashed into the pair address.
address tokenA parameter of pairFor, sorted before hashing.
address tokenB parameter of pairFor, sorted before hashing.
uint total local in batchSend accumulating _value * _tos.length.
uint i loop index local in batchSend.
address _to local inside the batchSend loop, read from _tos[i].
address UNI local inside the ensure modifier holding the computed pair address.
address token0 local in pairFor resulting from token sorting.
address pair local in pairFor holding the computed keccak256 pair address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the constructor, creating the privileged role.
transfer uses msg.sender as the implicit _from source for the forwarded transferFrom call.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before transferring balances.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping inside the unchecked allowance subtraction.
owner state variable gates the delegate function body.
owner state variable gates the batchSend function body.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable to authorize the transfer.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom is wrapped by the ensure modifier which executes its checks first.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the authorization check.
after the ensure checks pass, control returns to the transferFrom body.
delegate performs an external delegatecall to an arbitrary owner-supplied address, enabling arbitrary code execution and potential reentrancy.
the address parameter a is used directly as the delegatecall target.
the bytes parameter b is passed as calldata into the delegatecall.
the _value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without overflow protection.
the _from parameter selects which balance is decreased by the unchecked subtraction.
the balanceOf state variable is directly mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
the _to parameter selects which balance receives the unchecked addition.
the _value parameter is added to balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
the balanceOf state variable is directly mutated by the unchecked addition.
the allowance state variable is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
the _value parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance without overflow protection.
the _tos array length parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication.
the _value parameter is multiplied by the recipient count without overflow protection.
batchSend executes the unchecked multiplication to compute the total payout.
batchSend executes the unchecked subtraction of total from the caller balance.
the total local variable is the operand subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
the balanceOf state variable is directly mutated by the unchecked subtraction in batchSend.
the _value parameter is an input to the total local variable.
the _tos array length is an input to the total local variable.
the result of the unchecked multiplication is assigned to the total local variable.
the loop index i selects the current recipient from _tos into the _to local.
the _tos array supplies the recipient address stored in the loop local variable.
batchSend computes the total payout amount from _value and _tos.length.
the constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
the constructor assigns totalSupply.
the _supply constructor parameter is written into totalSupply.
the _name constructor parameter is written into the name state variable.
the _symbol constructor parameter is written into the symbol state variable.
the constructor seeds balanceOf, including the full supply for msg.sender.
pairFor computes and returns the pair address local variable.
tokenA is hashed into the computed pair address.
tokenB is hashed into the computed pair address.
the factory address is packed into the pair address hash.
the sorted token0 local is used in the pair address hash.
pairFor computes token0 via token address comparison.
the ensure modifier stores the pairFor result in the UNI local for the authorization comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: the _to destination parameter only carries the recipient index for the transferFrom balance update and should collapse into that function.
the _value amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance subtraction and is subsumed by that unsafe operation.
the _from source parameter is only used to index balances and allowances inside transferFrom.
the _spender parameter is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
the address a parameter is the delegatecall target and is consumed entirely by that unsafe operation.
the bytes b parameter is the delegatecall calldata and is consumed entirely by that unsafe operation.
the _tos recipient array is iterated only inside batchSend.
the _name parameter is only stored by the constructor.
the _symbol parameter is only stored by the constructor.
the _supply parameter is only used to initialize totalSupply and the owner balance in the constructor.
the factory parameter is used solely as a hash input inside pairFor.
the tokenA parameter is used solely as a hash input inside pairFor.
the tokenB parameter is used solely as a hash input inside pairFor.
the total local is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication and should merge into that unsafe operation.
the loop index i exists only to drive the batchSend loop.
the per-iteration _to local exists only inside the batchSend loop.
the UNI local is the pairFor result used only by the ensure authorization check.
the token0 local is an intermediate sorting value used only inside pairFor.
the pair local is the return value computed inside pairFor.
